nom: TATCHA The Silk Sunscreen SPF 50 Weightless Mineral Sunscreen

avis.texte: I love Tatcha products, but this suncreen leaves my skin looking pink.

avis.titre: Use caution when buying from Ulta
avis.texte: This sunscreen is lovely and I would like to use it but Ulta keeps sending me expiring product. I received a tube last week expiring this month, 6/2026. Ulta sent me a replacement which will expire next month, in 7/2026. Now my account is under review and I am left wondering if I will even get another replacement. Such a bummer for an expensive product. I would expect a sunscreen to not expire for at least a year. So yes, I would recommend this product, but not from Ulta, at least not online where you cannot see an expiration date prior to purchase.
Bought this for my mother in law, saw improvement less than a week

I prefer tinted, zinc-based sunscreens, but this one blows my usuals out of the water. It does not pill with my routine. The texture is heavenly—so light and silky. The finish really gets me: its not matte or dewy, and my skin just looks balanced. I've been using it for three months, 3-4 days a week, and the bottle still isn't empty. Based on the size, I was a bit skeptical about how long it would last, and I anticipate that if I end up using it all summer, it'll go much faster. My skin hasnt been irritated or broken out from it. Give it a try!
I love this product. I instantly noticed a difference in the look of my skin and disappearance of fine lines. I only wish it was cheaper.
This mineral sunblock is a fane changer for me. I was getting tired of the old sun blocks feeling heavy and greasy on my face. This is seriously the best mineral sunblock I've used.

Does not break me out, the absolute easiest to apply, no rubbing, no cast, slight tint is very glowy and flattering. I really dont like wearing any other sunscreen, but this just feels like a light, beautiful moisturizer. It is truly the very best sunscreen, nothing else compares.

This was gifted by Tatcha. Tatcha has once again made waves with their latest sunscreen. As a devoted fan of Tatcha, I am obsessed. The sunscreen is incredibly hydrating, making it a must-have addition to my skincare routine.

I love how easily this complimentary from tatcha milky spf blends into my skin without making my skin feel greasy or making my makeup get patchy. It is super smooth for my skin and really helps with sun damage

This sunscreen has a truly lightweight texture it absorbs fast, leaves zero white cast, and doesn't feel greasy or heavy on my skin. It layers perfectly under makeup without pilling and gives a smooth, natural finish. It keeps my skin hydrated, protected, and looking fresh all day.

Gifted by Tatcha Finally, an SPF that doesn't feel heavy! The milky consistency is lovely and easy to blend. It's helped even out my skin tone and fade sun spots. A luxurious experience that makes protecting my skin feel like a treat.

complimentary from tatcha. i've been loving this tatcha sunscreen! i love how im able to layer underneath my makeup with no issues! it also does not feel super heavy and my face feels super moisturized! definitely recommend if you're looking for a sunscreen!

My skin loves this formula of sunscreen. There's no white cast and it's not sticky. Very similiar in texture to most Korean sunscreens. My only problem is the packaging is super messy, there's nothing stopping the sunscreen from coming out of the top of the bottle. I want to travel with this sunscreen but I would for see it being a nightmare. Just using it in my bathroom in the morning is a mess. But the actual product itself is so amazing for my dry acne prone skin. I didn't really have a problem with reapplication and it came off easy with some micellar water.

I received this complimentary from Tatcha. I love this new milky SPF and it feels great. It is not sticky, oily, or tacky nor does it leave a white cast on my face. Will be using this as a part of my daily skincare routine!

avis.titre: Can't believe this is a Tatcha product
avis.texte: Smells like plastic. Does not feel silky at all. Takes a bit to rub in, and does not leave a white cast (seemingly the only redeeming factor). The container is not practical for dispensing the product. Honestly all of the negative reviews were right and I ignored them because I didn't think Tatcha could put out a product this bad. Will absolutely be returning.
I had such hight hopes, but unfortunately, this spf broke me out horribly!!! My skin still recovers and it's been almost two weeks now. Do not recommend for acne prone skin!

I like the idea of sunscreen in a moisturizer. However this product isn't very moisturizing to me. I like the way it goes on but I'm getting dry patches after I apply. I'm putting enough on. I do like it doesn't irritate my eyes.

I had high hopes for this sunscreen, as I love other Tatcha products. However, this was a huge disappointment. The product does not blend easily. The first time I applied it, it felt like I had to use so much product to make sure I covered everything. I will not be purchasing this product again.

avis.titre: I will repurchase this over & over
avis.texte: I am allergic to regular sunscreen and as an oily/combo skin it was hard finding a mineral sunscreen that wasnt oily, wouldnt clog my skin & wouldnt absorb & sit on my skin greasy all day. This tatcha sunscreen is perfect! I am on my third bottle & will continue purchasing. I have sensitive skin & this has never broke me out. In fact the opposite, its helped me clear my skin. Sure its tiny for the price but on my face its worth it. On my neck i use regular sunscreen lotion. I LOVE

This is overall my favorite sunscreen. I have repurchased this at least three maybe four times. I took advantage of the half off sale & was disappointed when I received it bc the expiration date is literally 06 of 2026 which is in 5 months And I'm currently using the one that I have opened and was not planning on opening the new one until I need it which would probably be after June which makes it then expired so I'll definitely be switching it for a much later expiration date. it's just frustrating bc when you're ordering something that cost that much you expect the date that it expires to not be within a year at least!!!

This sunscreen is very thin and feels weightless, but it's hard to blend in and it's almost like you didn't apply anything at all. It's to the point that I'm concerned I didn't have enough sun protection. I ended up returning it.

avis.titre: I heard great things, but it's meh
avis.texte: I was feally excited to try this because I heard such great things about Tatcha, but it falls flat for me. It makes my face feel really dry and I feel like I have to use so much of it at a time. I will finish the bottle, but will not repurchase.

I have tried an array of sunscreens and this is not my favorite. For the price, this is not worth it IMO. The main issue is that it is hard to spread around your face, I'm used to adding sunscreen on with my fingers but I have to use a face brush.

I like Tatcha a lot and really thought this product was going to work well for me. I have dehydrated combination skin. Tzone can get oily, periorbital/mouth area/lower face leans on the drier side. I dont have acne but I AM prone to getting clogged pores if I use heavy, cheap skincare. But generally speaking, depending on my skin's needs, whatever I use typically never breaks me out. That was all until I started using this stuff. After almost a week of daily use, I started breaking for out for the first time in a LONG time. I gaslighted myself into believing that it was just from me eating too many carbs, but no, it was from this sunscreen. It is way too much of a rich, greasy, heavy, formula and it doesnt absorb well at all. It leaves a thick oily pink hue/film. Its so rich that if you use any skincare underneath it, you look like you "slugged" with diaper cream. I use the proper amount of sunscreen for my face which is three solid finger lengths. It is like rubbing in motor oil. It applies like foundation and settles into eye creases in smile lines, never sets. Most importantly, this congested my pores and gave me texture so bad. In the 24 hours of stopping use, my skin is already improving and flattening out. I wouldnt never recommend this to anyone, its awful.

I love this sunscreen! I was a bit skeptical since I'm oily but it does wonders! It doesn't leave a white cast like regular sunscreen and didn't make me feel greasy. I haven't worn it under makeup yet but I do love it by itself! I would definitely buy this again in the future.
This is one of my favorite sunscreen to use. It's pricey but I appreciate ulta including this item on sale which was more encouraging to buy

I have dry skin and my skincare is topnotch,i only use mineral sunscreens but this is the only sunscreen which cause redness. I was expecting better product from Japanese Skincare Brand but this particular product is made is USA.
the best mineral sunscreen i have ever used. i genuinely don't know how this product was formulated to not have a white cast and be SPF 50 PA++++ insanely good!
I have tried so many sunblocks for the face. This is the only one that i can use.
I bought in store and it was half off so that was a plus and i didnt burn and my skin looked glowy in a non oily way as an oily skin girly
I really like this sunscreen, it looks great alone or under my makeup. I would recommend giving it some time to set in before applying any makeup.

this is honestly the best sunscreen ive ever used! I keep repurchasing because its soooo good for my skin! Ive been trying to find a cheaper alternative but nothing compares. Its silky, does not pill, and works well under makeup.

avis.titre: Best mineral sunscreen I've tried so far!
avis.texte: This sunscreen has worked wonderfully for my dry and sensitive skin. It is simply amazing. Does not leave a white cast. It may pill if rubbed for long, but I have found it works perfectly if you just dab it in. Gives a nice finish.

avis.titre: Best Face Sunscreen I've Ever Used
avis.texte: This formula is light weight and does not leave a white cast! It works well under foundation and does not pill. I find the smell to be very light upon applying but fades quickly and is not over powering. I have sensitive skin and this formula has never given me a break out or irritation!
This is absolutely wonderful.. it made my skin feel like silk and my makeup stayed fresh

I have been looking for a mineral sunscreen that isn't drying or visible and this was a good find for me. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling comfortable. After using for a week and have had no problems with irritation or break outs. Would recommend

avis.titre: Wanted to love, won't be buying again
avis.texte: I love how lightweight the product is. However, when re-applying throughout the day I have conssitently experienced pilling. Disappointed that the sunscreen pills all over my hands when re-applying…especially at this price point

avis.titre: Wanted to love, won't be buying again
avis.texte: I love how lightweight the product is. However, when re-applying throughout the day I have conssitently experienced pilling. Disappointed that the sunscreen pills all over my hands when re-applying…especially at this price point

avis.titre: Might be good if you don't have sensitive skin
avis.texte: I wanted to love this, and upon first application I really did love it, it blended in easily, had a very silky texture and finish, and wore nicely throught the day, buy by the time came to take it off, I noticed clogged pores starting to form on my cheeks. I wanted to give it another chance so I went back to my tried and true skincare products for a few days and make sure this was the only new addition, and it was same story, I loved it on initial application, but by the end of the day my skin was irritated and had bumps. If you are acne prone, I would reccomend patch testing first. Also, it may go without saying, but the PRICE?!!! There are defiteily better options for much better prices.

I got this in my gratis as an associate and i was really excited to try it out. Unfortunately on the first go it pilled on top of my other skincare which is weird since I use the tatcha water cream after my serums. I don't understand why their sunscreen would pill on their moisturizer. I've had inconsistent results where sometimes it pills and sometimes it doesn't, even with the same routine. The times it doesn't pill I have no complaints. I do like the finish, and it works to protect my skin but I wouldn't purchase it for the price.

Fake hype- I gave this product many many opportunities to prove itself… yet I had a sunburn each time. I put lots on … a thin layer… re-applied..: just wrong when you ate trying to prevent skin cancer and you end up burnt.
I have sensitive skin and have used this twice now. It is super drying and caused my face to breakout pretty badly afterwards. Wish I had saved the box so I could return.
I received this last week and when i put it on my face it smells old. I just cant get past the smell unfortunately. Not sure if i got a bad batch or what.
This is great spf for the summer. It is slightly tinted and provides good coverage for the day.

I like the product since I live in Arizona and it makes my skin really dry so this moisturizer works well. The only thing about it is that I notice the bottle leaks, I don't know if it's just mine (like I got a bad batch) but that's the only real issue I have with it.
I honestly LOVE this product!!!! 😍 Never going back to any spf! It doesn't leave a white cast! Its smooth! It doesnt make my face Oily! It makes it soft! I FINALLY found the one!
I honestly LOVE this product!!!! 😍 Never going back to any spf! It doesn't leave a white cast! Its smooth! It doesnt make my face Oily! It makes it soft! I FINALLY found the one!

I have extremely sensitive skin. My face loves this product. It disappears and looks so natural. I used it every day on my trip to Egypt. I did not even get a hit of sunburn. I bought more so I won't risk running out of it.
This product is definitely worth trying. Great sunscreen, lightweight, works well under makeup, but it is expensive. One of the best sunscreens i ever tried.
This product is definitely worth trying. Great sunscreen, lightweight, works well under makeup, but it is expensive. One of the best sunscreens i ever tried.
It's not lying when they say "silky". It is so hydrating and no gross spf smell.

At first when i was rubbing it on i felt like this is a little thick but once its rubbed in you dont feel it and it looks so dewy on the skin. Ill start by saying i dont have too many skin issues i can use anything as long as its not fragrance heavy (personal preference) so to me this with a little cute lip combo is the best
The moisturizing aspect of this cream is nothing short of amazing. My skin has never felt so soft, and not just on the surface either.
Leaves my face feeling dry, even over a good moisturizer. It got my face looking red too, my cosrx vitamin E sunscreen rubs in better
This sunscreen is amazing. Its not greasy, its light weight and silky on the skin. It evens out my skintone Ive gotten compliments on how smooth my skin is without foundation and just this!

I've only purchased this in the "new" packaging. Sounds like the printing on the bottle doesnt wear off now. My issues are that the lid comes off easily, and I haven't had it leak during air or car travel, picking it up by the lid from my vanity drawer has led to the lid coming off and spillage. The formula is heaven. I'm a long time Rx retinoid user with melasma and rosacea, and this is less drying than other zinc-only formulas. Summer and winter, it's easy to apply, even when i have some flaky skin, which has been the deal breaker for me and many, many, many other sunscreens. This has a tint, but it only evens my skintone slightly, if you're a foundation user, you'll still want to use it. My NARS foundation applies well over it when I have done that. On normal work days i just use concealer and finishing powder over it. I do think it helps keep my melasma from worsening on normal work days to and from the office. For gardening I typically wear something that's cheaper that i can reapply with abandon. This brand isn't ever going to get cheaper. Ulta carries Blume, which makes an almost identical sunscreen, but for some reason they aren't carrying it. Anyway, if you can afford Tatcha and are looking for a physical sunscreen that's high SPF and cosmetically elegant, this is an option you should try.

I love this sunscreen. It is non-irritating and offers good protection. There is also a tint to it, so I have no issues with it leaving a white cast like many mineral sunscreens. It doesn't feel heavy at all and has a slight blurring effect that I think makes my skin look more even and glowy. The newer packaging is a relief too and easier to manage.

avis.titre: Easy to apply, great sunscreen coverage
avis.texte: I love this product. I don't travel, and I actually really love how easy the packaging makes this product to apply. It is runny, which I love, so easy to apply. Gentle in my face, doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I wear it under my makeup. Love it!
It's great. Doesn't pill on my skin, goes on great slight tint. I Like it so much better then Clarins. It's up there with glo which I also love.
I love this sunscreen Not greasy or oily It works great under makeup and I feel confident with the coverage I was out all day in South Carolina sun and it fully protected my face

I love the product itself The texture is very soft and leaves my skin shiny I hate the packaging I recently came back from vacation and found the sunscreen spilled all over inside my Tatcha travel bag Ive lost a lot of the product itself from the spill and Im upset since the product is not cheap To conclude I wish Tactha can come up with a better design of the bottle to prevent future spills especially for those traveling

This sunscreen is wonderful! It goes on so smooth and lightweight Its not oily and wears great under makeup The fact that its SPF 50 makes it even better Like the name implies it feels like silk !! Love it !!

avis.titre: Great product less than ideal packaging
avis.texte: I really love this product but really don't like the packaging!!! The packaging leaked while I was on the plane Fortunately I had placed it in a small plastic bag Coming home I wrapped it better again in a plastic bag and put it in my suitcase - it leaked even more I have tried so many sunscreens and this is by far my favorite I do not even need foundation when I use it just a little concealer You might want to try a screw on and off top ike La Roche Posay Athelios which helps the top popping off with pressure This is an expensive sunscreen to loose so much when you fly

I am incredibly disappointed in Tacha with this product With how expensive the brand is you would think they would make sure to make a sunscreen that is inclusive to ALL SKIN TONES I thought beauty brands would FINALLY start to acknowledge their darker skinned customers yet here we are in 2024 still dealing with this problem I expected more from Tacha as I do love their moisturizers so to say I was shocked and disappointed with how this appeared on my skin would be an understatement Im grateful mine was just a sample but this makes me really not want to buy any more products from this company If other brands can make inclusive AND protective sunscreen then there is zero excuse for Tacha to have a product like this Truly truly disappointed

I like the Tatcha Silk Sunscreen for my skin because it has 10 zinc oxide in it which is effective to prevent sun damage It has a skin-colored tint to smooth the unevenness of my skin tone And it has a matte finish which I like

avis.titre: Love the product hate the new packaging
avis.texte: I love this sunscreen its lightweight and blends well with my skin tone I travel quite a bit and every time the packaging leaks Ive tried carrying on in a ziploc but it leaks all over the bag A pump or a tube may work better

avis.titre: Great product packaging better but still problematic
avis.texte: Let me start off by saying this is absolutely my favorite sunscreen formula I can't use anything else after having this I was so happy to see the new bottle no more peeled off paint on my face However like many other reviewers mentioned the bottle cap is terrible It does not securely stay on the bottle which defeats the purpose of a cap and renders this not travel friendly I use a hair tie to hold the cap but tying it top to bottom but even then it still comes off and leaves products leaking Please use a twist top or something else more secure Please!!
This serum spf is an amazing product and the improved packaging makes me a die hard fan

I unfortunately can't give this product a full 5 stars like I want to I love the The Silk Sunscreen and the subtle tint makes it such a great product I never wore sunscreen consistently everyday until I started using this one That being said it has now spilled in make up bag several times with the lid on You have to have to leave it standing straight up or it will do this Even if you lay it down on your counter come back after a work day and sunscreen will be everywhere just because it is knocked over and not sitting up straight Basically the cap doesn't contain the product it fill the lid then starts dripping out the sides and all over everywhere And I have made sure it is properly sealed every time since it happened the first time but it continues to do so I'm super disappointed as this product is not the cheapest so I am losing SO SO much product and money I'm estimating that about a third of my sunscreen has leaked out over the use of this product It's starting to be enough to keep me from buying this again until they do something about his TATCHA PLEASE FIX THIS It is not travel consumer friendly
This sunscreen has helped my face feel Moisturized while being protected

avis.titre: If I could have returned I would
avis.texte: Smells like plasticine Its awful and I cant use it because of that Complete waste of money and there was no way I could get a return

It is amazing leaves my skin moisturized glowy and protected No breakouts and I have been using it over two months Normally other sunscreens would have broken my skin out within a few days I already ordered my third bottle
I like the texture and the fact that it doesnt leave a buildup The container is improved however at some point the cap loosens and keeps detaching

avis.titre: Favorite Sunscreen but the Packaging is AWFUL
avis.texte: This is definitely my new favorite sunscreen for daily use It does not leave a white cast And you only need a little bit of product It does really well if you need to build multiple layers on top of it In theory this one bottle should last you a while but due to the faulty packaging if the bottle is accidentally inverted in your suitcase all of the product dumps into the cap and spills onto your other products Its super frustrating to have to worry about wasting half of your money and half of a great product

avis.titre: New Container Needed NOT new product
avis.texte: Ive used the Silk Sunscreen since you brought it out and love it I do not want to change but maybe Ill have to The container takes such strength to squeeze enough product out that its painful Soften the material the container or do a pump method Please consider changing it or just a simple screw off cap
Great sunscreen is very light on the skin and doesn't leave a shiny oily finish However the package is terrible as it keep leaking when we travel
This sunscreen is a little runny and doesnt have the best smell

avis.titre: Love the product but dissatisfied with packaging
avis.texte: Really love the sunscreen It feels good on skin Only disappointing thing is the packaging It is not at all travel friendly The lid does not close properly and sunscreen was leaked in bag The packaging needs to be improved For a high range product and brand like this it was very disappointing to see such cheap packaging
This is the best sunscreen Ive tried and Ive tried a lot The texture and slip make it easy to use everyday-even under makeup! Love
This sunscreen is very light weight and goes on smoothly It also creates a slight blur so it almost acts as a primer Very happy with this purchase
I had to return this product It dried my skin I use other products from TACHA and love it But not this one

avis.titre: Happy with the product but not the container
avis.texte: A bit disappointed with silk sunscreen container While it has sleek and flattened shape which fits for travel when opened it is no longer securely closed The container survived international travel when unopened After that product was spilled all over the cosmetic bag I had to wrap it all in plastic and put in separate ziplock bag even then it still spilled It is a pity since I like this sunscreen and containers are pretty but flawed in usage
Nice new container but really tuff on my fingers having to press so hard to get the sunscreen out
I seldom where foundation cause the slight pinkish tint in this is just enuff coverage A bit tuff to squeeze out of container but doable

I love this sunscreen for daily wear! Its lightweight and not oily or smelly Ive noticed if I only use face sunscreen and end up spending too much time outside my face is totally fine and my arms will have a little sunburn The only thing I wish was different is the packaging It is not great for travel and every time I pack it I arrive with a sunscreen mess The lid pops off and if it gets squished or pressurized at all the product goes everywhere A locking pump would be sooo nice

avis.titre: LOVE the product not the packaging
avis.texte: I LOVE this sunscreen! it feels lightweight and leaves my skin looking better so I don't need to wear foundation I took this with me when I went on vacation only to realize that half the product had leaked because the cap doesn't close properly So make sure you seal the cap properly or tape it together if you plan on traveling with it Otherwise is a great product I even gifted one to my mom and she loves it

I love this sunscreen It dries with a mostly matte finish and it doesnt feel like youre wearing anything The color is really just a hint I have used a lot of sunscreens that make your face look white so the tiny bit of tint keeps that from happening I will repeat this purchase - a new staple of my daily skincare routine

I am so glad the packaging was changed!! I still think a pump bottle would have been best but this is so much better than the old packaging but with the same great product THANK YOU Tatcha for listening to our complaints about the old packaging and making this change I'm not finding the bottle shedding purple film on me as I use it and it's not exploding with a surge of product unless I open it in a very specific way Instead I just get the smooth silky SPF that doesn't have any potent scent like most SPFs there's no residue or odd shine and it works well in combination with my other cosmetics and makeup You can't even tell I have sunscreen on even in photos Best sunscreen out there and my favorite Tatcha item right after the Dewy Skin Cream
Great smooth formula with a little light tint Doesnt clog my pores Love it
Ive been looking for this sunscreen my whole adult life! It has everything- matte finish Slight tint creamy application spf 50 Highly recommend 1510

I really like this product Most other high number spf products make my skin feel like it blocked and suffocating This is milky and smooth It's easy to apply and works well under makeup My only critique is that it can cause little balls of product if I use a different brand moisturizer

avis.titre: Perfect formula but we need a yellow undertone option!
avis.texte: Oh how I wanted to hate this sunscreen it's pricey for every day protection But alas it's perfect well almost more on that in a minute I love that the formula is thin which makes it so easy to apply And it's quite silky as the name implies The formula includes 10 zinc oxide which is the magic number Any less and you're not getting adequate protection Any more and it dries the heck out of my skin zinc is an astringent But this product is very hydrating without the grease I have large pores and textured skin so all of these shiny SPFs look just awful on me and highlight every imperfection This one is dewy without crossing into disco ball territory It's the only sunscreen I've tried where I actually enjoy wearing it and don't rush home to scrub it off Lastly it's watersweat-resistant up to 80 minutes That is a must for me as I like to run outside Here's the one thing that would make this product a holy grail item for me please please offer this sunscreen in a YELLOW undertone This one is suuuper pink and clashes terribly with my light Italian skin Bananas need a little love too!
The Silk Sunscreen is amazing and I like the texture and coverage as well Blends perfectly with my skin tone
